claims: David Adelman is the head coach of the Denver Nuggets as of the 2025-26 season.
David Adelman took over as head coach of the Denver Nuggets after Michael Malone departed.
Michael Malone departed the Denver Nuggets to become the head coach at North Carolina.
David Adelman was previously a top assistant under Michael Malone.
David Adelman joined the Denver Nuggets in 2017.
David Adelman is noted for leading the league's top offense.
Michael Malone led the Denver Nuggets to the 2023 NBA Championship.
The assistant coaches of the Denver Nuggets are Jared Dudley, JJ Barea, and Mike Moser.
